title: Add SQLite schema migration and compatibility checks
description: Review finding from loreweaver-den. SCHEMA_VERSION is stamped after CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS with no explicit migration path or compatibility check for existing campaign DBs. Parent context: loreweaver-d4r.
acceptance_criteria: Fresh DBs initialize correctly; current DBs are recognized; at least one old-version fixture migrates or fails clearly; newer unsupported DB versions are refused without partial mutation.
close_reason: Added pre-mutation schema compatibility checks, clear SchemaCompatibilityError failures for newer/older/unversioned DBs, and regression coverage for fresh/current/legacy cases; verification: npm run typecheck and npm run test passed; TDD evidence recorded.

comments.author: Joseph Bongaarts
comments.text: Worktree baseline: npm install succeeded with expected Node 24 EBADENGINE warnings for Node 22 package policy; npm run typecheck passed; npm run test passed with 36 files passed / 1 skipped and 240 tests passed / 2 skipped.

comments.author: Joseph Bongaarts
comments.text: TDD RED: focused persistence tests failed as expected. Newer schema_version was accepted instead of throwing; legacy unversioned DB was partially mutated by initSchema creating all tables before failing/deciding compatibility.

comments.author: Joseph Bongaarts
comments.text: TDD GREEN/REFACTOR: added pre-mutation schema compatibility checks and SchemaCompatibilityError; npx vitest run packages/core/test/persistence.test.ts passed with 8 tests; npm run typecheck passed.

comments.author: Joseph Bongaarts
comments.text: Verification: npm run typecheck -> exit 0; npm run test -> exit 0 with 36 files passed / 1 skipped and 244 tests passed / 2 skipped. TDD evidence recorded: RED showed newer and legacy schemas were mishandled; GREEN/REFACTOR passed persistence suite.
